SELECT T1.STATUS_BATCH AS statusBatch, T1.PROD_ID AS prodId, T1.PROD_NAME AS prodName, T1.SURFACE_IN_OUT AS surfaceInOut, T1.PROD_BRAND AS prodBrand, T1.PROD_STAGE AS prodStage, T1.RAISE_CCY AS raiseCcy, T1.RAISE_AMT_PLAN AS raiseAmtPlan, T1.TOTAL_AMT AS totalAmt, T1.SALE_AMT_STR AS saleAmtStr, T1.RAISE_VDATE AS raiseVdate, T1.RAISE_ENDDATE AS raiseEnddate, T1.CASH_PRIN_CCY AS cashPrinCcy, T1.CASH_PROF_CCY AS cashProfCcy, T1.VDATE AS vdate, T1.MDATE AS mdate, T1.LOW_YIELD AS lowYield, T1.HIGH_YIELD AS highYield, T1.IS_CONSTRACTE AS isConstracte, T1.RISK_LEVEL AS riskLevel, T1.PROD_MANAGE_PATTERN AS prodManagePattern, T1.CONT_MODE AS contMode, T1.PROFIT_TYPE AS profitType, T1.PROD_SALEBANK_NAME AS prodSalebankName, T1.OPERATE_MODE AS operateMode, T1.CMMODE AS cmmode, T1.TERM_RIGHT_FLAG AS termRightFlag, T1.COOPERATION_NAME AS cooperationName, T1.INV_ASSET_TYPE AS invAssetType, T1.CUSTOMER_RISK_LEVEL AS customerRiskLevel, T1.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS customerType, T1.INVEST_ARAE AS investArae , T1.REMARK AS remark, T1.BANK_MARK AS bankMark , T1.DATE_STATUS AS dateStatus, T1.GROUP_ID AS groupId FROM CHB_FINANCE_PRODUCTS_SUB T1
